title: Plain Hunt
oneLiner: A bell you let go of strikes two seconds late. Hold, release, and watch the other bells bend to cover your slip.
statement: A bell you let go of strikes about two seconds later, so you commit before you hear. Five other bells ring a fixed plain hunt around you. If your blow lands late, the bell behind you in that row bends to cover, and the row is true again within a few bells. The band is a rule, not people: its bells never err. The only mistakes are yours, and the record draws every one of them at its true time. Hold too long and the bell is set: it goes quiet and the band stands.
howToInteract: Press and hold to take the rope as the bell rises; release to ring. Space or Enter does the same.
Hold too long and the bell is set; press once to ring again.
The bell's edge lightens while you hold inside the slanted patch of daylight.
reducedMotion: The bell is drawn still and an arc with one dot shows its angle. Timing and rules are unchanged.
thumbnailAlt: A pale slanted band of daylight over a cream wall, an umber bell on a hub with a slack rope to a red sally, and rows of small dots at left.
